      • getZoneIds

        public static String[] getZoneIds()
        Gets all available IDs supported in the Java run-time.
        返回:
        a set of time zone IDs.

      • getZoneIds

        public static String[] getZoneIds(int rawOffset)
        Gets all available IDs that have the same value as the specified raw GMT offset.
        参数:
        rawOffset - the GMT offset in milliseconds. This value should not include any daylight saving time.
        返回:
        an array of time zone IDs.

      • getCustomTimeZone

        public static ZoneInfo getCustomTimeZone(String originalId,
                                         int gmtOffset)
        Gets a ZoneInfo with the given GMT offset. The object has its ID in the format of GMT{+|-}hh:mm.
        参数:
        originalId - the given custom id (before normalized such as "GMT+9")
        gmtOffset - GMT offset in milliseconds
        返回:
        a ZoneInfo constructed with the given GMT offset
